notes.title: Soft, Cuddly, and Ready to Abandon You - the Explorer Plushies Are Here!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Explorers,[/h2][p]We have some [i]very[/i] exciting news to share: we worked together with [url="https://www.makeship.com/"]Makeship[/url] to design We Were Here plushies and the campaign is [i]live[/i] starting [b]today![/b] Meet the [i]Best Friend[/i] and [i]Worst Friend[/i] plushies, inspired by all those times your buddy either saved you… or locked you in the dungeon “by accident.”
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/7cf64833e15a1ae080ee4fb4eac9cef24aad50bc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]How it works[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Support the campaign by [url="https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/total-mayhem-games"]grabbing your plushie(s) on Makeship.[/url][/p][/*][*][p]If we reach 100% funding, the plushies are officially going into production.[/p][/*][*][p]Didn’t make the goal? No worries, everyone gets a full refund.[/p][/*][*][p]Once funded, your new fluffy partners take 2–4 months to make, then ship right to your door.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]✨ [b]A little bonus[/b][/h3][p]Can’t choose? Don’t! If you pick up [i]both[/i] the Best Friend [i]and[/i] Worst Friend plushies, you’ll get [i]5% off[/i], because let’s be real: [i]We Were Here[/i] is always better with a partner.[/p][p]Keep both as a trophy for your “flawless” comms, or gift one to your partner-in-crime so they never forget who really left who behind…
[/p][h3]🔗 [b]Bring them home:[/b] [/h3][p]💙 [url="https://www.makeship.com/products/best-friend-plushie"]Best Friend Plushie[/url][/p][p]😈 [url="https://www.makeship.com/products/worst-friend-plushie"]Worst Friend Plushie[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]We can’t wait to see these little buddies on your shelf (or stuck in Castle Rock with you). Let’s make it happen, [/b][b][i]together.[/i][/b]
[/p][h3]- Total Mayhem Games
[/h3]

notes.title: The We Were Here series is coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Explorers,[/h2][p][/p][p]Some of you know these halls all too well. You’ve wandered the frozen corridors of Castle Rock, walkie-talkie in hand, voice cracking through the static. You’ve solved puzzles, shouted directions, cracked codes, and yes, maybe left your partner behind once or twice. It happens.[/p][p]For years, the [i]We Were Here[/i] series has tested friendships on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. Now, it’s time for a new expedition.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]We’re super excited to announce that [i]We Were Here[/i], [i]We Were Here Too[/i], and [i]We Were Here Together[/i] are coming to Nintendo Switch![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="TF6n0lMsYv0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Your favourite co-op adventure is going handheld (or docked, if you want to see your friend betray you on the big screen).[/p][p]To play on Switch, you’ll need two things: a Nintendo Switch Online Membership and an external microphone. The trilogy will also be backwards compatible with the Switch 2, so whether you’re playing on shiny new hardware or your trusty old console, you can still team up together. As always, you and your friend will both need a separate copy of the game you want to play.

If you're new here, [i]We Were Here[/i] games are all about two players, trapped apart in a forgotten place, trying to escape through communication alone. You won’t see each other, and can only talk to each other over your walkie-talkies. Every puzzle you solve depends on how well you work together.[/p][p]If you’re a weathered Explorer, this is your chance to bring a new partner to Castle Rock. That friend who only games on Switch? Time to hand them a walkie-talkie and hope they’re better at reading runes than you were.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're playing curled up in a blanket fort or squeezed into a train seat, remember:[/p][p]You’re never truly alone…[/p][p][/p][h3]See you on the other end of the walkie-talkie,
[b]Total Mayhem Games[/b][/h3]

tags.feature: We’re super excited to announce that [i]We Were Here[/i], [i]We Were Here Too[/i], and [i]We Were Here Together[/i] are coming to Nintendo Switch!

notes.title: Happy Holidays Explorers!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5b32b809c18fb587ff28d73d15a35c84b57f9fda.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5b32b809c18fb587ff28d73d15a35c84b57f9fda.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Ho, ho, ho, Explorers! 🎄[/h2]

[b]The holidays are here, and from everyone at Total Mayhem Games, we wish you happy holidays and all the best for 2025![/b] It’s been quite the year! Maybe a quiet one on the surface, but trust us, behind the scenes at our Rotterdam base camp, it’s been anything but. We’ve been hard at work preparing for the adventures to come, and we’re thrilled to head into the new year with all of you by our side.

But what’s a holiday season without a little something to unwrap? 🎁 We’re kicking things off with a [b]6-day advent calendar[/b] (in full We Were Here style, of course)!

[h2]🎶 Day 1: Cozy Lo-Fi Tunes for Every Explorer[/h2]

We’re starting things off with a musical treat! If you’ve seen the [url=https://youtu.be/UFM6xBz_18o][b]YouTube video[/b][/url] featuring remixes of the original We Were Here soundtracks in lo-fi style, you already know the vibe. As of today, you can also find them on [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/6JOpn6nak2HJCajID9w2Lu?si=mCSsCCMlSP2eSkMVZYnfFw][b]Spotify[/b][/url]. Whether you’re studying, commuting, or just relaxing by the fire, these tunes will bring some Antarctic calm to your day. 🎧

[previewyoutube=UFM6xBz_18o;full]https://youtu.be/UFM6xBz_18o[/previewyoutube]

[h2]✨ What’s Next? Stay Tuned![/h2]

[b]Over the next five days, we’ll be revealing a new surprise each day.[/b] A little spoiler? Some seriously cool merch featuring brand-new artwork has just dropped. If you can’t wait, you can sneak a peek [url=https://www.totalmayhemmerch.com/]here[/url]. Otherwise, [b]keep an eye on our [url=https://linktr.ee/WeWereHereSeries]socials[/url] and let the surprises unfold!
[/b]
[h2]Christmas at Base Camp 🎅[/h2]

For those craving a festive co-op adventure, [b]we’ve brought back the holiday-themed puzzle at base camp in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/?curator_clanid=33033900]We Were Here Together![/url][/b] Grab your favorite Explorer, whip up some hot cocoa, and dive in for some wintry fun.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/251f64f8d7d8919519f6b3afc6f315df9e2beed3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/251f64f8d7d8919519f6b3afc6f315df9e2beed3.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Winter Sale Alert![/h2]

Oh, and don’t forget: the Steam Winter Sale is live now, and the [b]We Were Here games are available with some sweet discounts.[/b] If there’s a game missing from your collection (or you want to gift one to a friend), now’s the perfect time to grab it. Check out the deals:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/677160/We_Were_Here_Too/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/?curator_clanid=33033900

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/?curator_clanid=33033900

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296990/We_Were_Here_Expeditions_The_FriendShip/?curator_clanid=33033900

[h3]Stay warm, stay adventurous, and enjoy the holidays!
— The Total Mayhem Games Team
[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.
notes.content:
Explorers! Ensuring the best and smoothest gameplay experience is very important to us. We hear you! Today we released a small patch that contains several fixes for issues that got reported by the community.
 
Patch 1.0.2. contains the following changes:
 
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Stuttering videos on PS4 / Xbox One and some PC's configurations.
[*] Posters are not fully legible on some settings.
[*] Player can get stuck between pillars in the teamwork challenge.
[/list]
 
[b]Improved[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed redundant 'play without save' option from the main menu.
[/list]
 
[b]Things we're currently looking into for the next patch[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes when completing the game with a perfect score a score of 0 / 0 / 0 is displayed.
[*] Missing subtitles at some points in the boat ride.
[*] The end screen story is sometimes only based on just the first challenge.
[*] Text is being cut-off in the EULA screen.
[*] Lighting in the teamwork challenge does not turn back on after a retry.
[*] Random crash after x amount of time.
[/list]
 
If you still run into any issues, please check out our support page:
https://totalmayhemgames.com/support/support-we-were-here-expeditions-the-friendship/
For some direct support, reach out to us on our socials or join our [url=https://discord.gg/wewerehereseries]Discord[/url] server.

notes.title: All aboard The FriendShip!
notes.content:
Hello Explorers!

Think you and your bestie can take on any challenge together? We’d like to see you try. [b][i]We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip[/i][/b] awaits you!

[previewyoutube=aPHRenQug3g;full][/previewyoutube]

In this bite-sized new series from the main [i]We Were Here[/i] games, you’ll put your friendships to test! 

You and your partner take the role of an Antarctic Explorer pair, hearing a distress call that might be familiar to some of you. Eager to answer the call, you try to identify the location, but the weather that’s brewing outside causes their focus to wither . You end up at an uninhabited island which has an amusement park?! If you’re able to find your way in, a series of puzzling trails await the two of you, where Communication, Teamwork and Trust are of the essence. You won’t be able to pass them alone, so be sure to work together…

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/a6a8784b44876221d4b4f5d944e3e15812bef17d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/a6a8784b44876221d4b4f5d944e3e15812bef17d.gif[/img][/url]

You can now take your ultimate friendship test for [b]free[/b] until [b]October 13[/b], so be sure that you and your bff (or are they?) have claimed the game before this date. It will be yours forever to keep. And it doesn’t matter which platform you and partner will play on, as the game is [b]playable cross platform[/b]! So you can truly test your friendship across platforms.

If you’re new to the [i]We Were Here[/i] series, don’t worry. This is a complete new experience, so you and your partner can jump into the test without any worries. Well, the only worry you might have is failing the friendship test. ;) We from Total Mayhem games are known for co-op adventures, focusing on the cooperation between the two players! The asymmetrical element of our games give it an extra layer, where you and your co-op partner are truly depended on each other. If you like to level your smarts, while going through a puzzling adventure, our games are sure to be something for you!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/e0b56b7e1c49f6f6b1cd9835a6031e31c31463c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/e0b56b7e1c49f6f6b1cd9835a6031e31c31463c1.png[/img][/url]

For our veteran Explorers, this might be a fun little side experience for you to play! Although there are some small lore implications to the main [i]We Were Here series[/i], this is a new series bringing bite-sized co-op puzzle experiences. Who knows, maybe this is the gateway for that one friend you’ve been bugging for so long to play the game! Since once you enter the Antarctic and fall into the grasp of Castle Rock, you’ll never truly leave…

We want to ensure you all as well that this doesn’t mean that our main [i]We Were Here[/i] series is completed. We’ve got a lot more adventures planned for you, this is just a small little side quest for you ;)

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/9d5ac8a41be0b764f12d5d557c8f99e459b95249.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/9d5ac8a41be0b764f12d5d557c8f99e459b95249.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2] Join the main series [/h2]
Are you interested in seeing where this series originated from? The [i]We Were Here[/i] series is an asymmetrical puzzle co-op adventure with [b]4[/b] games! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12260/We_Were_Here_Series/

If you think you and your friend are ready for the real deal, get started on our other games!  Our latest game [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] will be on sale with [b]35% off[/b] later today at 7PM CEST.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/

[h2] Show off your bestie [/h2]
Be sure to share your friendship results with us on social media using hashtags #PlayTheFriendShip #WeWereHere or in our [url=https://discord.gg/wewerehereseries]Discord[/url].
And who knows, you might get featured on our social media and win some prizes!

[i][b]Bon voyage![/b][/i]
